summary.text: Tristan Leavitt is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 53, which he has represented since December 2024, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He holds a law degree from Georgetown University.

paragraphs.text: Tristan Leavitt earned a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 2007 and a law degree from Georgetown University in 2011.
He took office in the House of Delegates on December 1, 2024, succeeding Republican Chris Pritt, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
